entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Meanwhile, Gus Manger had invited m..."
entries.dialogueText: Meanwhile, Gus Manger had invited me to visit the Gasom headquarters in Narbel. It was situated in Ornobel, a neighborhood on the city outskirts.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Next to it was the Damenoy gas rese..."
entries.dialogueText: Next to it was the Damenoy gas reserve, a prominent natural gas source consisting of four large fields.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The roads were bumpy and marked by..."
entries.dialogueText: The roads were bumpy and marked by potholes, while the buildings surrounded us appeared run-down and dilapidated. The community had apparently endured a prolonged period of neglect.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We came to a halt at the entrance g..."
entries.dialogueText: We came to a halt at the entrance gates of the facility. A sizeable mural depicting the Gasom logo had been painted on a nearby wall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a series of intense meetings..."
entries.dialogueText: After a series of intense meetings with Ciara and Paskal, I decided to take some much-needed time to recharge.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I checked in with Lucian and Petr b..."
entries.dialogueText: I checked in with Lucian and Petr back at the capital. They were working hard to unite democratically leaning reformers for the crucial task of drafting a new constitution.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I checked in with Lucian and Petr b..."
entries.dialogueText: I checked in with Lucian and Petr back at the capital. They had devoted themselves to the challenging task of uniting pro-centralization factions behind the drafting of a new constitution.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I checked in with Lucian and Petr b..."
entries.dialogueText: I checked in with Lucian and Petr back at the capital. They were engaged in intense negotiations with the Old Guard in order to address their pressing national security concerns.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I checked in with Lucian and Petr b..."
entries.dialogueText: I checked in with Lucian and Petr back at the capital. They were working tirelessly, exploring all possibilities and avenues to advance the constitutional reform draft.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ewald Alphonso stood up from his ch..."
entries.dialogueText: Ewald Alphonso stood up from his chair. He had on a perfectly tailored suit that he wore as casually as pajamas.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: "“Gus, you old devil.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Gus, you old devil.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adjacent to the mural, a group of i..."
entries.dialogueText: Adjacent to the mural, a group of individuals wearing blue work vests had assembled, holding what looked like protest signs.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Good day, President Rayne. Welcome..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good day, President Rayne. Welcome to Gasom's Narbel operations!"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It takes one to know one. As promi..."
entries.dialogueText: “It takes one to know one. As promised, I've brought our guest of honor.”

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: "“President Rayne. I hope you enjoye..."
entries.dialogueText: “President Rayne. I hope you enjoyed seeing our facilities here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“President Alphonso. It's nice to s..."
entries.dialogueText: “President Alphonso. It's nice to see what you have built from the inside.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The facilities appear to be in muc..."
entries.dialogueText: “The facilities appear to be in much better shape than the city around them.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Greetings. I'm curious to find out..."
entries.dialogueText: “Greetings. I'm curious to find out more about where Gasom stands.”

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: "“It's fine. Nothing compared to the..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's fine. Nothing compared to the Gasom HQ in Holsord, of course."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You should have seen Narbel before..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should have seen Narbel before Gasom came here. The jobs it generated have had a lasting positive effect."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The same sentiment applies to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The same sentiment applies to the government's stance on our energy policy."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Still one of the standouts of the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Still one of the standouts of the Maroon District.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""It's true. Things here could be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true. Things here could be a lot worse."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Plenty of discussions we can have...."
entries.dialogueText: “Plenty of discussions we can have. We have the two new faces of Sordland in one room. The old man is nowhere to be seen.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We sat down. Some snacks and drinks..."
entries.dialogueText: We sat down. Some snacks and drinks were served. Multiple Gasom yearly financial reports were scattered on the table between us.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: "“Please have a seat. Let's talk.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Please have a seat. Let's talk.”

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: "“If we raise a minority investment,..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we raise a minority investment, it would allow us to invest in further resource excavations in the gas fields, and turn the company back to significant profitability.”

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: "“By significant, I mean that our pr..."
entries.dialogueText: “By significant, I mean that our projections show that we would be able to cover eighty percent of Sordland's gas needs in three years, and we would achieve profits four times the value of our investment.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If we are to invest in Gasom, I wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we are to invest in Gasom, I want to make sure that the company is also committed to improving the socio-economic conditions in Narbel."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your projections sound impressive...."
entries.dialogueText: "Your projections sound impressive. However, we need to consider the international market as well. How do we plan to compete against nations like Anraka, Arcasia, United Contana?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I understand your concern. The ris..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your concern. The risk is indeed there, but our experienced team of geologists and engineers have identified promising fields."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Ewald's got a point, Mr. President..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ewald's got a point, Mr. President. Sure, there's some risk, but look at the upside -- Sordland could be energy resilient. I reckon that's a gamble worth taking, especially in these tough economic times."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ewald walked back over to the windo..."
entries.dialogueText: Ewald walked back over to the window. He stood there, silhouetted against the vast expanse of the gas fields.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I wholeheartedly agree. The well-b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wholeheartedly agree. The well-being of Narbel's citizens is a priority for Gasom."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""An enticing proposition. However,..."
entries.dialogueText: "An enticing proposition. However, I would like to know more about the risks involved. What if the excavations do not yield the expected results?"

entries.dialogueText: "Your attitude and choices as President has prompted me to reflect on the significant gap that exists between us. Regrettably, this divide could pose challenges to the feasibility of any prospective business collaboration."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Mr. President, I believe we have t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I believe we have the potential for a mutually beneficial partnership. However, we need to align our objectives and expectations."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""We've got a strong strategy in pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've got a strong strategy in place. Our competitive edge lies in the quality and efficiency of our production."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The odds are in our favor. And let..."
entries.dialogueText: "The odds are in our favor. And let's not forget the potential rewards are substantial."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""With this investment, we could cer..."
entries.dialogueText: "With this investment, we could certainly allocate some funds to improve the local infrastructure and create more jobs."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""With this investment, we can furth..."
entries.dialogueText: "With this investment, we can further enhance our technologies and stay ahead of the competition."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Mr. President, I've been thinking..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I've been thinking -- what if we tie Gasom's growth to Narbel's development? Get the company to invest in the community, you know? That way, everybody wins."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Ewald and his team have been doing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ewald and his team have been doing a hell of a job. Give them the right backing, and I reckon Gasom could give the big boys a run for their money. We just need to have a little faith."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Mr. President, your administration..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, your administration's focus on a planned economy resonates with our strategic vision."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Mr. President, your administration..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, your administration's commitment to a market economy aligns with our vision for a competitive corporation."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""A government investment in our com..."
entries.dialogueText: "A government investment in our company aligns perfectly with this approach. It's about strengthening Sordland's economy and becoming self-sufficient in energy production."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""With a government investment, we c..."
entries.dialogueText: "With a government investment, we can further liberalize the energy market, enhance our technologies, and compete globally."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Kingdom of Rizia's investment..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia's investment would reduce the risk for us. However, we need to carefully consider the implications of sharing control with a foreign entity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm heavily interested in the idea..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm heavily interested in the idea of Gasom investing in Narbel's development. But we need concrete actions, not just words."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I see the potential for us to driv..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see the potential for us to drive Sordland's energy independence. But we need to make sure this is a sustainable solution."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You bring up a valid point. We're..."
entries.dialogueText: "You bring up a valid point. We're dedicated to responsible resource extraction and have allocated a portion of the proposed investment for environmental mitigation measures."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The partnership with Rizia is inde..."
entries.dialogueText: "The partnership with Rizia is indeed a new venture for us, as a company, Anton. However, they have a vested interest in a stable gas supply."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You're right to demand specifics...."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right to demand specifics. With this investment, we aim to improve the living conditions in Narbel by creating more jobs, providing better housing for our workers, and initiating educational programs."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Sustainability is a key part of ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sustainability is a key part of our strategy."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Our agreement would be focused on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our agreement would be focused on operations and profits, but not policy – Gasom would remain under Sordish control."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Gasom is as committed to Narbel as..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gasom is as committed to Narbel as it is to Sordland."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Couldn't agree more, Mr. President..."
entries.dialogueText: "Couldn't agree more, Mr. President. We've got to keep the big picture in mind, and that includes our environment. I trust Ewald and his team to handle this responsibly."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Mr. President, I know the Rizians..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I know the Rizians want the same thing we do. And the more energy partners we have, the better off we'll be. Plus, we'll keep the reins on Gasom."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""It's about time Narbel got a leg u..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's about time Narbel got a leg up. Ewald's plan sounds solid to me. More jobs, better living conditions – that's a step in the right direction."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll co-invest with Rizia. We'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll co-invest with Rizia. We'll share the costs and stakes."
entries.menuText: "We'll co-invest with Rizia. We'll share the costs and stakes." [-1 Government Budget]

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We won't invest at this time. Let..."
entries.dialogueText: "We won't invest at this time. Let the Kingdom and other foreign investors contribute."
entries.menuText: "We won't invest at this time. Let the Kingdom and other foreign investors contribute."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We're investing alone. Sordland wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're investing alone. Sordland will provide the majority of funds, and Gus will tell Rizia to back off."
entries.menuText: "We're investing alone. Sordland will provide the majority of funds, and Gus will tell Rizia to back off." [-2 Government Budget]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a moment, he turned back to f..."
entries.dialogueText: After a moment, he turned back to face us. His gaze was steady, the expectation clear in his eyes. The time had come to make a decision.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Before we dive into the celebratio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before we dive into the celebrations, I've allocated time during this meeting for President Rayne to discuss any concerns regarding Gasom's treatment of its workers and its effects on Narbel."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your decision shows a commitment t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision shows a commitment to Sordland's energy independence. We won't let you down."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""A joint investment? A wise choice...."
entries.dialogueText: "A joint investment? A wise choice. It ensures steady funds for Gasom."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I understand your reservations. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your reservations. We'll continue to serve Sordland's energy needs."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""That's a bold move, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a bold move, Mr. President. But I reckon it's the right one. Gasom's success will be Sordland's success."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I like the way you think, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: "I like the way you think, Mr. President. Sharing the costs with Rizia reduces our risk and strengthens our ties. It's a smart move."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Well, Mr. President, you've always..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Mr. President, you've always been one to play it safe. I guess we'll just have to make do and see how things turn out."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The wages of Gasom blue-collar wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "The wages of Gasom blue-collar workers need to be increased. They are the backbone of your operations."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I expect Gasom to contribute signi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I expect Gasom to contribute significantly to local charities, to aid in the city's recovery."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The workers of Gasom need better h..."
entries.dialogueText: "The workers of Gasom need better housing, access to healthcare, and opportunities for education. As the leading industry there, Gasom can't ignore its responsibility."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We've covered a lot today. I belie..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've covered a lot today. I believe we can wrap up the meeting now."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""President Rayne, I appreciate your..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Rayne, I appreciate your concerns about Narbel. Rest assured, we are constantly evaluating our impact on the community and are looking for ways to improve."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Mr. President, while I acknowledge..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, while I acknowledge your concerns, Gasom's primary responsibility is to its shareholders and the economic stability of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""A good point. I see the potential..."
entries.dialogueText: "A good point. I see the potential for Gasom to play a larger role in supporting our workers and the community."

entries.dialogueText: "Ewald, your personal commitment to these initiatives speaks volumes. This could be a turning point for Gasom and for Narbel."

entries.dialogueText: "Gentlemen, it seems we have an unexpected situation outside. Some protestors from the Labor Union have blocked the main vehicular exits."

entries.dialogueText: "We are not blind to the socio-economic conditions here. We're deeply invested in this community and are committed to doing our part."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's a challenging task to balance..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a challenging task to balance the needs of our shareholders with our responsibilities. I cannot promise you anything."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""We understand the importance of fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "We understand the importance of fair compensation. Discussions are ongoing on how to best support our hardworking employees. That is all I can say for the time being."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""We must indeed be mindful of the e..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must indeed be mindful of the economic realities. We are striving to make decisions that are financially sound and sustainable."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger

entries.dialogueText: "Both of you make good points. It's a fine line between fulfilling our responsibilities and ensuring economic stability."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso

entries.dialogueText: "Donating more is an interesting idea. It's something we will consider."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso

entries.dialogueText: "Our contributions to Sordland's economy are substantial. Our focus must remain on maintaining that."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "That's true. And I hope that Gasom is ready to make some significant changes."

entries.dialogueText: "We're all in agreement, Gus. Now it's time to turn that agreement into action."

entries.dialogueText: "We understand the need for action, Mr. President, but also--"

entries.dialogueText: "As I mentioned before, we're always considering how we can--"

entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I assure you that Gasom takes its responsibilities--"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I agree, it's time for us to--""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, it's time for us to--"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""We are all on the same page here...."
entries.dialogueText: "We are all on the same page here. Let's not lose sight of that as we move forward."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm relieved to hear that. A fair..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm relieved to hear that. A fair wage is the least we can provide for the hardworking people of this country."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Promises are a start, Ewald. But t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Promises are a start, Ewald. But the people need actions, not words. I look forward to seeing concrete changes."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Ewald, your personal commitment to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ewald, your personal commitment to these initiatives speaks volumes. This could be a turning point for Gasom and for Narbel."

entries.dialogueText: "This is still promising. Ewald's commitment to these initiatives should alleviate some of our concerns."

entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't agree more. It's high time we took our responsibilities to Narbel seriously."

entries.title: Narrator: "He approached Alphonso and leaned i..."
entries.dialogueText: He approached Alphonso and leaned in to whisper something in his ear. Ewald nodded solemnly, his gaze meeting mine with a serious intensity.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Well, that's a pickle. What's our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, that's a pickle. What's our move, Ewald?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I have a helicopter ready. We can..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a helicopter ready. We can leave undetected and avoid the chaos and potential danger."

entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I have discussed the situation with the Presidential Guard and the police security. They are advising us not to go out the way we came in."

entries.title: Narrator: "Serge Wolkner rushed in."
entries.dialogueText: Serge Wolkner rushed in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ewald looked at me."
entries.dialogueText: Ewald looked at me.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""You must make a decision, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must make a decision, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As our motorcade made its way throu..."
entries.dialogueText: As our motorcade made its way through the Ornobel district, I noted the neighborhood's state of disrepair.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge skillfully parked the car, br..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge skillfully parked the car, bringing our journey to a smooth and elegant conclusion. Gus greeted us warmly as we stepped out of the vehicle.

entries.dialogueText: "That's a shame. I still believe there's potential for us to work together in some capacity."

entries.dialogueText: "I understand, Mr. Alphonso. It's important that we each stay true to our principles."

entries.dialogueText: "We each have our roles to play for Sordland. Let us each do what we believe is right."

entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your optimism, Mr. President. While this particular deal may not have worked out, I remain open to future collaborations that could benefit both our interests and Sordland."

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""If they don't point us in the same..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they don't point us in the same direction, then it's best we part ways here. I wish you all the best in your endeavors for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Hold on, gentlemen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hold on, gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger

entries.dialogueText: "You're right, Mr. President. There's always potential for collaboration. Let's not close the door just yet."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Wait. Gentlemen, let's not let a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. Gentlemen, let's not let a single disagreement define our relationship. There's a bigger picture here."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I understand that tensions are hig..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand that tensions are high right now. But I have faith that we can find a solution that benefits everyone."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""However, for that to happen, I nee..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, for that to happen, I need to know: Mr. President, do you trust my judgement?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Gus, I respect you, but I can't tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gus, I respect you, but I can't trust your judgement in this matter. You seem to have a fundamental bias on this."
entries.menuText: "Gus, I respect you, but I can't trust your judgement in this matter. You seem to have a fundamental bias on this." [Reject Deal]

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I trust your advice. You've proven..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust your advice. You've proven yourself a reliable ally and I believe we can find a way forward."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your judgement has been questionab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your judgement has been questionable at times. But I'm willing to hear you out."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Thank you, Mr. President. I propos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. President. I propose a compromise."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""If you promise not to tighten the..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you promise not to tighten the current restrictions of the Energy Protection Act, we can reconsider our stance and keep the deal on the table."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Mr. President, I'm giving you a ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I'm giving you a chance to prove your commitment to the people of Sordland and to our shared future."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I hope you'll consider our offer c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you'll consider our offer carefully. This could be the beginning of a fruitful partnership, or the end of a potential alliance."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Fair enough, Mr. President. I gave..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fair enough, Mr. President. I gave it my all."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""We both tried, it seems. Still, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "We both tried, it seems. Still, I appreciate the discussion, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Well, Mr. President? Will Gasom an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Mr. President? Will Gasom and Sordland make history or not?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Mr. Rayne, the foundation for a ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Rayne, the foundation for a robust partnership is right here. It's high time we shift our focus towards sealing this deal."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You've made a compelling case. Let..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've made a compelling case. Let's get this deal on the road. I can assure you that the EPA restrictions won't get any stricter."

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""If the Sordish government chooses..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the Sordish government chooses to invest, it would gain a voice in the broader company decisions, even as a minority stakeholder."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The government could either liquid..."
entries.dialogueText: "The government could either liquidate its shares at a future date or continue to reap the long-term profits."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""A beneficial arrangement for all p..."
entries.dialogueText: "A beneficial arrangement for all parties."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Excellent, Mr. President! Your sup..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent, Mr. President! Your support for the homeless cause is commendable. Together, we will ensure a promising future for Gasom."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Mr. President, your assurances on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, your assurances on the EPA front are much appreciated. This partnership is going to bring great benefits for all."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""You know, Mr. President, if we can..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know, Mr. President, if we can get the government in on this, it's a win-win."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Not only does Gasom continue to op..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not only does Gasom continue to operate and grow, but it also strengthens the state's energy security and economic power. We just need a little risk appetite, that's all."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Are you ready, Mr. President, to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you ready, Mr. President, to take on the risks that come with ensuring one of Sordland's most valuable energy companies continues to operate and grow?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Are you ready to make your governm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you ready to make your government stronger?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't you think there's a way we c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you think there's a way we can ensure Gasom's growth without putting the government at risk?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What kind of assurances can you pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "What kind of assurances can you provide that this will pay off in the long term, President Alphonso?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm all for taking calculated risk..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm all for taking calculated risks. But we need to be sure that the benefits outweigh the potential losses."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Alphonso, are you suggesting t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Alphonso, are you suggesting that we should risk the treasury of Sordland for the growth of a single company?

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Not at all, Mr. President. I'm sug..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not at all, Mr. President. I'm suggesting that supporting Gasom's growth could significantly contribute to Sordland's overall economic stability."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Of course, Mr. President. I wouldn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Mr. President. I wouldn't propose a strategy that I didn't believe would be beneficial for both Gasom and Sordland."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Gus, would you like to answer that?""
entries.dialogueText: "Gus, would you like to answer that?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Mr. President, in business, there..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, in business, there are no guarantees. But I can assure you that we at Gasom are committed to doing everything in our power to ensure this deal pays off for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Ewald is right. We're not talking..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ewald is right. We're not talking about risking the economy. We're discussing an investment that has the potential to pay significant dividends for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""As someone who's been in the energ..."
entries.dialogueText: "As someone who's been in the energy business for decades, I can tell you that this deal is solid."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Absolutely. I believe that by work..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely. I believe that by working together with Rizia, we can find a shared investment solution that promotes Gasom's growth while minimizing any potential risk to the government."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I can't give you a guarantee. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't give you a guarantee. But I can tell you that I trust President Alphonso, and I believe in this deal. Sometimes, you have to take a leap of faith."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Mr. President, have you ever consi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, have you ever considered that the future of Sordland might rest not on avoiding risks, but about embracing them?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I understand your point. However,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your point. However, the stakes are too high for us to gamble on uncertainty."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have. And I believe that embraci..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have. And I believe that embracing uncertainty is a part of leadership. We must be bold in our decisions for the future of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That our greatest potential might..."
entries.dialogueText: "That our greatest potential might lie not in the safety of what we know, but in the uncertainty of what we might discover?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Liberalizing the energy market mer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Liberalizing the energy market merely serves the interests of the wealthy elites. What we need is a comprehensive nationalization of the energy sector to ensure it serves the people, not profit."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""While I respect your perspective,..."
entries.dialogueText: "While I respect your perspective, Mr. President, I firmly believe that the power of the free market, coupled with appropriate regulation, can drive both progress and equity. It's not an 'us versus them' situation."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""We must also consider the economic..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must also consider the economic realities and global competitiveness. A balance between public ownership and market forces could be the key."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A thriving market economy is the e..."
entries.dialogueText: "A thriving market economy is the engine of prosperity and innovation. I believe in Gasom's potential to compete and succeed under these principles."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I'm glad we see eye to eye on this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad we see eye to eye on this. With your support, I am confident that Gasom will be able to chart a prosperous future."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Your words are reassuring, Mr. Pre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your words are reassuring, Mr. President. Let's harness the power of the free market to elevate Gasom and, in turn, the entire Sordish economy."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I understand, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's unfortunate we couldn't bridg..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's unfortunate we couldn't bridge our differences. Nonetheless, we respect your stance and value the time spent."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Ready to make history together? Se..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ready to make history together? Set our differences aside and work together for the energy independence of our nation?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Katarina Horten and Denis Stahler..."
entries.dialogueText: "Katarina Horten and Denis Stahler seem to be leading the group. It would be difficult to leave the way we came without causing trouble."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A helicopter might be the safer op..."
entries.dialogueText: "A helicopter might be the safer option."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I think we should face the crowd h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we should face the crowd head-on."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is there no other way out?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is there no other way out?"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Mr. President, I advise you to lea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I advise you to leave via helicopter just in case. I can stay back and update the crowd on the discussions today."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I will give the order to ready it...."
entries.dialogueText: "I will give the order to ready it. We can fly to the Blue Mansion in Lachaven."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That is your prerogative, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is your prerogative, Mr. President. Following the violent events of late, I heavily recommend against facing any crowd."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Trust me, I know this place well...."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust me, I know this place well. The only other way out is through a dangerous hilly terrain or the sewers."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""More police are on the way.""
entries.dialogueText: "More police are on the way."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I appreciate your visit today, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your visit today, and despite our differences, your willingness to meet with me is noted."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Throughout my journey, I've held f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Throughout my journey, I've held faith in collaborating with individuals who genuinely share my vision. The presence of the right allies amplifies our potential."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I'll leverage my Rizian contacts t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll leverage my Rizian contacts to finalize the deal."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Our allies in the Golden Kingdom w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our allies in the Golden Kingdom will step in where Sordland couldn't."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not here for your approval, Al..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not here for your approval, Alphonso. My priority is Gus and, more importantly, the workers."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That sounds eerily like what Mr. S..."
entries.dialogueText: "That sounds eerily like what Mr. Soll would say when things didn't go his way."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Let's not get heated.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not get heated."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must make decisions based on wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must make decisions based on what is best for Sordland in the present moment."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Running the state is not like runn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Running the state is not like running your company Alphonso. You out of all people should know this."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""The Labor Union and the Communist..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Labor Union and the Communist Party of Sordland have garnered significant support, capitalizing on the anxieties of the many Gasom workers concerned about their job security."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""The worried workers will have no f..."
entries.dialogueText: "The worried workers will have no fears about job security thanks to this state intervention."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""The Labor Union, along with the Co..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Labor Union, along with the Communist Party of Sordland, has rallied substantial support from Gasom workers in Narbel, advocating for improved local conditions."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We need to address these concerns;..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to address these concerns; they could jeopardize the administration."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our duty is to listen and take act..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our duty is to listen and take action. That's the mandate granted to us by the public."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Gasom stands as a global energy po..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gasom stands as a global energy powerhouse. It's only right they give back somewhat."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Together, we might discover soluti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, we might discover solutions beneficial to both parties."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Very well, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've wasted enough time to this. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've wasted enough time to this. Time to depart."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's regrettable you feel this way..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's regrettable you feel this way, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""While sometimes people may not alw..."
entries.dialogueText: "While sometimes people may not always recognize what's in their best interest."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Let's mull it over.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's mull it over."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A member of the private security te..."
entries.dialogueText: A member of the private security team entered the room, his face taut with urgency.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Look, gentlemen. My time is valuab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look, gentlemen. My time is valuable, so let’s cut to the chase."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Blunt. Must be the new way of doin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Blunt. Must be the new way of doing things."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don’t forget, the state stands abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don’t forget, the state stands above you all. Nothing may happen today, or next week, but the future is never certain."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I have served Sordland all my life..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have served Sordland all my life. It’s the people who voted for me, just like they did for you."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""We’re all civil servants here.""
entries.dialogueText: "We’re all civil servants here."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I think it's time to call Mr. Mont..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think it's time to call Mr. Montoro, Gus."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Thank you for making the trip and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for making the trip and setting aside the time."
